notes.title: SpaceNET 1.13.0 - the Unknown Island
notes.content:
Dear Space Adventurers,

I'm really happy to announce the second major update for [b]SpaceNET[/b]!
It is shipped with amazing [b]new content[/b] and a lot of [b]new features[/b]:

[h1]The Unknown Island Episode[/h1]
This is the second story content update for SpaceNET. 

Do you always wanted to become a pirate?
And did you think it wouldn't be possible to rent a boat at Xylo Harbor? The boat rental season just started again! Rent a boat for one, two or three days and explore the ocean... and figure out what's wrong there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823452/295eca5d70b368837baad69d0a11da418a033c0c.png[/img]
There is an unknown island...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823452/7213d8e2437f9c6039065076bc05e56532705ccd.png[/img]
Navigate and explore the sea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823452/01c4db586962305fb6873e670d805689c801d0a4.png[/img]
Maybe the boat rental company can help?

[h1]More stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*] New dialogues with a lot of improvements
[*] Many new silly jokes
[*] Many new items
[*] New graphical assets
[*] Improved cockpit planets
[*] New sounds and atmospheres
[*] New terminal commands
[*] Some small bug fixes
[/list]

[b] If you like it: PLEASE write us a short REVIEW. Thanks![/b]

That's it for now. 
I wish you a lot of fun, and be careful with the boat!

notes.title: SpaceNET 1.12 - a New Episode!
notes.content:
Dear Space Adventurers,

I'm really happy to announce the first major update for [b]SpaceNET[/b]!
It is shipped with amazing [b]new content[/b] and a lot of [b]new features[/b]:

[h1]Asteroid Field Episode[/h1]
This is the first story content update for SpaceNET and quite a big one. 
One person in the game will give you a hint how to find it. When you're arrived there, you... SPOILER CENSORED.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823452/f417c196b62d7165a05298a40a18f7af098d7692.png[/img]
Flying through the asteroid field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823452/19261cc9a28e19834faf9aaca60848b6dcfbe4f0.png[/img]
Land on 4 different asteroids.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823452/8608aab1d7bb77439c8be6a94efa2f8f41b6dbeb.png[/img]
What is this?

[h1]New dialogues[/h1]
A big rewrite has been done one the dialogues to emphasize the mysteries of the story. The NPCs got more character, and the story got more deepness as well as many weird jokes ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823452/e1c21d5b8944c7b11c2f3766bfbff3e2daa37125.png[/img]
Don't try to fool this guy.


[h1]Dialogue History[/h1]
This is a log of all spoken dialogues. Really handy to remember the last story interactions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823452/4a65dc3899c78a5735b49f40dcb709a8e49081d2.png[/img]
The Dialogue History.

[h1]More new and old stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mouse hover on Action Points - get back the point'n'click feeling!
[*] Mouse hover on the Space Menu with interactive button description
[*] Many many typos corrected
[*] Some small bug fixes
[/list]

That's it for now. 
I wish you a lot of fun, and be careful while flying through the asteroid field!

notes.title: Version 1.10: New inventory controls and a help screen
notes.content:
Dear SpaceNET adventurers,

Version 1.10 is out! 
Changelog:
* new inventory controls: right-click to open/close the inventory, mouse wheel to quick-select items
* a new help screen with some information and all shortcuts
* a couple of typos have been corrected as well as some tiny bugs

Some other good things are coming really soon!
* the whole text is in proofreading right now
* a big content update is coming with something really special... :)

All the best
